I am 64 years old and my family has farmed this land for generations, so I know the soil here in the North West is not fertile. I will buy a few bags of subsidized NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer because without it the maize will not yield well, but I cannot afford much. I will plant the seed I saved from last season since improved seed is too expensive and I do not fully trust it, and my sons and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves because there is no money to pay hired workers. We will rely on the rains and will not use chemicals on this plot because pesticides are costly and I only see others spray them on cowpea and vegetables.
